verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains nothing about NVLink, Infinity Fabric, multi-GPU interconnect, or rack-scale deployment for the RTX 5090 — it only covers gaming features (DLSS, Reflex, ray tracing) and generic CUDA toolkit docs shared across all NVIDIA GPUs. GeForce RTX 5090 is a consumer gaming card and, unlike datacenter parts, has no documented NVLink or fabric interconnect for multi-GPU scaling, so this datacenter-scale story is unsupported by any cited evidence.
